title: George Orwell Radio Collection
paragraphs: A radio anthology of George Orwell's novels, essays, memoirs, and related biographical dramas, including BBC treatments of major works such as Nineteen Eighty-Four and Animal Farm.
Curated BBC Radio collection combining readings, adaptations, biographical dramas, essays and factual programs about George Orwell. Frozen rows are archive objects, not one continuous series.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Legacy BBC Orwell productions (May 5, 1988 to November 16, 2009) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]], Factual/biographical lead-in (2010 to September 18, 2012) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]], and The Real George Orwell season (January 26, 2013 to February 23, 2013) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Joseph Millson (performer), Clive Merrison (performer), David Jackson Young (producer), Jeremy Mortimer (director), Christopher Eccleston (performer), Jonathan Holloway (radio adaptor), and P. G. Morgan (radio adaptor and producer).

The stories often return to George Orwell / Eric Blair, BBC radio adaptation and preservation, totalitarianism and authoritarian power, George Orwell biography, socialism, class and political economy, and dystopian surveillance society.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes The Real George Orwell BBC Radio 4 season, George Orwell and the Spanish Civil War, and Eric Blair in colonial Burma.
